e.title: Cefor / NoMIS（北欧水险协会）：共享理赔统计与「船体理赔通胀指数」
e.title_en: Cefor / NoMIS (the Nordic Association of Marine Insurers): shared claims statistics and a hull claims inflation index
e.title_hk: Cefor / NoMIS（北歐水險協會）：共享理賠統計與「船體理賠通脹指數」
e.summary: 北欧水险协会：以 NoMIS 共享统计提供年度与半年度水险理赔数据（2021–2026 年度档），并发布「沿海船体通胀指数」——按钢铁/材料/人工权重结合挪威统计局三个指数合成，且自行声明与实际损失成本可能背离
e.summary_en: The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers: its NoMIS shared statistics provide annual and half-yearly marine claims data (with 2021–2026 archives), and it publishes a "Coastal Hull Inflation Index" composed from steel, materials and labour weights combined with three Statistics Norway indices — while stating itself that it may diverge from actual claims cost trends
e.summary_hk: 北歐水險協會：以 NoMIS 共享統計提供年度與半年度水險理賠數據（2021–2026 年度檔），並發布「沿海船體通脹指數」——按鋼鐵／材料／人工權重結合挪威統計局三個指數合成，且自行聲明與實際損失成本可能背離
e.body:
**Cefor（The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers，北欧水险协会）** 是**北欧水险业的行业组织**（站点页脚自述为「Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway」）。本条目补的是**「专业险种自己的共享数据层」这一形态**：**实测池内水险/货运险/船舶险相关条目为 0**——**注意一个假命中**：关键词「hull」曾命中 [[hull-white-esg-checks]]，**但那是 Hull-White 利率模型，与船舶险无关**；同理 [[insurance-python]] 只是模块名巧合。**故「水险」此前是真正的空白险种**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 200，标题实测 **「Home」**；⭐ **「Statistics」页 `/statistics/` 实测 14.5KB**；⭐ **「NoMIS（Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics，北欧水险统计）」页 `/statistics/nomis/` 实测 12.2KB**，正文实测写明 **「Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics」**（**可下载 NoMIS 报告、协会年报与半年度的 NoMIS 统计**），页面实测列出 **2026 / 2025 / 2024 / 2023 / 2022 / 2021 共六年年度档**，并给出数据联系人；⭐ **「Coastal Hull Index（沿海船体指数）」页 `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` 实测 14.7KB**，正文实测写明 **「The ‘Coastal Hull Inflation Index’ is one example for how a claims inflation index for Norwegian coastal hull business may be composed as a weighted index」**，并说明 **「The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)」**——**即按「钢铁 / 其他材料 / 人工」的典型平均赔款占比加权，再与挪威统计局（SSB）的三个指数结合**；**同一页 Cefor 自行声明局限**：**「One should however be aware that the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index and show a higher variance from year to year」**，并写明 **「Recently, the actual claim cost inflation in the Nordic coastal hull portfolio exceeded that of the calculated index derived from SSB figures」**（**近期实际理赔成本通胀高于按 SSB 推算的指数**）；⭐ **「Cefor in Figures」页 `/statistics/market-overview/` 实测 15.1KB**，正文实测写明 **「Download the latest as well as historical versions of Cefor Fact Sheets and Market Premium Overviews」**，实测档期含 **2026 Cefor in Figures**、**2025 Cefor Facts**、**The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)**、**2024 Cefor Facts**、**2023 Cefor Facts** 等；**「Hull Clauses」页 `/clauses/hull-clauses/` 实测 23.5KB**；**「2026 Mid-year hull report」页 `/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/` 实测 11.1KB**；导航实测另含 **Nordic Plan（北欧计划，标准水险合同）**、**Cargo Clauses（货运条款）**、**Small craft clauses（小艇条款）**、**Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions（北欧离岸风电保险条件）**、**Safety regulations**、**Interest Rates**、**Ask the analyst**、**NoMIS Special focus analyses**、**Broker’s Letter of Authority**、**Code of Conduct**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「水险」这一整条业务线**——池内险种侧此前**极密于寿险/健康险/车险/财产险/巨灾**，**唯独水险与货运险为 0**；水险是**历史最久的专业险种之一**（船体与货物），**对想做 specialty lines 的学生，这是一个从零开始的入口**。**② ⭐ 「理赔通胀指数」是本轮最有教学价值的发现**——池内已有 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]]（马来西亚车险理赔通胀）与 [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]]（通胀感知的超额赔款准备），而 **Cefor 给出的是「第三种险种、且方法论完全公开」的理赔通胀构造**：**按成本构成（钢/材料/人工）加权 → 挂接国家统计局的三个投入指数**；**更难得的是它把方法的局限写在页面上**（**合成指数与实际赔款趋势可能背离、逐年方差更大**）——**这对做「理赔通胀假设」的学生是一个可直接引用的方法样本与警示**（可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 并读）。**③ 「共享理赔统计」这一机制本身值得注意**——**由行业组织汇总多家公司的理赔数据形成共同基准（NoMIS）**，这**不是监管强制申报，也不是公开数据，而是行业自组织的共享池**；对研究**数据共享激励机制**的学生，这是一个与 [[susep-sro]]（监管强制逐笔登记）**完全相反的路线**。**④ 离岸风电保险条件与港口/沿海业务的条款也在此站点**——[[oasis-piwind]] 是离岸风电的开放灾损模型，**两者正好构成「条件（条款侧）+ 模型（量化侧）」的一对**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量、六年年度档列表、指数方法论表述与 Cefor 自述局限、以及条款与条件的导航条目**，**但未下载任何 NoMIS 报告、未下载任何年度档、未打开沿海船体指数文件本身、未打开任何 Fact Sheet 或保费概览、未打开任何条款文本**，因此**不能转述任何具体损失率、保费规模、指数数值或条款条文**；**② 沿海船体指数的具体数值与权重比例本次未读取**（**只读到方法描述与定性结论**）；**③ 站点设有 Log in 区域**，**会员专区的内容范围本次未核实**；**④ NoMIS 的成员覆盖范围（几家会员、覆盖哪些国家）本次未核实**；**⑤ Cefor 与北欧各国监管、与 IUMI 的关系本次未核实**；**⑥ 首页标题实测仅为「Home」，信息量低，故本词条的标题与摘要依据各功能页而非首页**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Cefor 提供精算软件或建模工具。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/statistics/`（14.5KB）、`/statistics/nomis/`（12.2KB）、`/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/`（14.7KB）、`/statistics/market-overview/`（15.1KB）、`/clauses/hull-clauses/`（23.5KB）、`/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/`（11.1KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取方法论段落；**未下载报告、指数文件、Fact Sheet 或条款文本**。
e.body_en:
**Cefor (the Nordic Association of Marine Insurers)** is **the trade body of the Nordic marine insurance industry** (its footer reads "Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway"). This entry adds the **"specialty line’s own shared data layer"** form: **a measured count found zero entries on marine, cargo or hull insurance** — and note **a false positive**: the keyword "hull" matched [[hull-white-esg-checks]], **which is the Hull-White interest-rate model, not marine insurance**; likewise [[insurance-python]] is a naming coincidence. **Marine insurance was therefore a genuinely empty line of business**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage returns 200 with the measured title **"Home"**; ⭐ the **"Statistics" page `/statistics/` measures 14.5KB**; ⭐ the **"NoMIS (Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics)" page `/statistics/nomis/` measures 12.2KB** and states verbatim **"Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics"**, listing measured **2026 / 2025 / 2024 / 2023 / 2022 / 2021 archives** (six years) plus a named data contact; ⭐ the **"Coastal Hull Index" page `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` measures 14.7KB** and states verbatim **"The ‘Coastal Hull Inflation Index’ is one example for how a claims inflation index for Norwegian coastal hull business may be composed as a weighted index"**, explaining that **"The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)"** — **weighted by the typical average share of claims going to steel, other materials and labour, combined with three Statistics Norway indices**; **on the same page Cefor states its own limitation**: **"One should however be aware that the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index and show a higher variance from year to year"**, adding that **"Recently, the actual claim cost inflation in the Nordic coastal hull portfolio exceeded that of the calculated index derived from SSB figures"**; ⭐ the **"Cefor in Figures" page `/statistics/market-overview/` measures 15.1KB** and states verbatim **"Download the latest as well as historical versions of Cefor Fact Sheets and Market Premium Overviews"**, with measured issues including **2026 Cefor in Figures**, **2025 Cefor Facts**, **The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)**, **2024 Cefor Facts** and **2023 Cefor Facts**; the **"Hull Clauses" page `/clauses/hull-clauses/` measures 23.5KB**; the **"2026 Mid-year hull report" page measures 11.1KB**; measured navigation also includes the **Nordic Plan** (a standard marine insurance contract), **Cargo Clauses**, **Small craft clauses**, **Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions**, **Safety regulations**, **Interest Rates**, **Ask the analyst**, **NoMIS Special focus analyses**, **Broker’s Letter of Authority** and **Code of Conduct**.

For RIAA: **① it adds an entire line of business** — the corpus’s line-of-business side is **very dense in life, health, motor, property and catastrophe**, **yet marine and cargo were at zero**; marine is **one of the oldest specialty lines** (hull and cargo), **a from-zero entry point for students interested in specialty lines**. **② ⭐ The claims inflation index is this round’s most instructive find** — the corpus already holds [[claims-inflation-motor-my]] (Malaysian motor claims inflation) and [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]] (inflation-aware excess-of-loss reserving), and **Cefor supplies a third line of business with a fully disclosed method**: **weight by cost component (steel, materials, labour), then link to three national statistics indices**; **rarer still, it states the method’s limitation on the page itself** (**a composed index may diverge from actual claims trends and varies more year to year**) — **a directly citable method sample and caution for students setting claims inflation assumptions** (readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[gi-loss-reserving]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]). **③ The "shared claims statistics" mechanism is itself notable** — **a trade body aggregating member claims data into a common benchmark (NoMIS)** is **neither a mandatory regulatory return nor open data, but an industry-run sharing pool**; for work on **incentives for data sharing**, this is **the mirror image of [[susep-sro]]** (a regulator-mandated operation-level registry). **④ Offshore wind insurance conditions and coastal clauses sit here too** — [[oasis-piwind]] is an open catastrophe model for offshore wind, so **the two form a "conditions (wording side) plus model (quantitative side)" pair**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes, the six-year archive list, the index methodology wording and Cefor’s own stated limitation, plus the clause and conditions items in navigation**, **but downloaded no NoMIS report, no annual archive, did not open the Coastal Hull Index file itself, opened no fact sheet or premium overview and opened no clause text**, so **no loss ratio, premium volume, index value or clause wording can be restated**; **② the index’s actual values and weight proportions were not read** (**only the method description and qualitative conclusion**); **③ the site has a Log in area**, and **the scope of member-only content was not verified**; **④ NoMIS membership coverage (how many members, which countries) was not verified**; **⑤ Cefor’s relationship to Nordic supervisors and to IUMI was not verified**; **⑥ the homepage title measurably reads only "Home" and carries little information, so this entry’s title and summary rest on the functional pages rather than the homepage**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim Cefor provides actuarial software or modelling tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/statistics/` (14.5KB), `/statistics/nomis/` (12.2KB), `/statistics/coastal-hull-inflation-index/` (14.7KB), `/statistics/market-overview/` (15.1KB), `/clauses/hull-clauses/` (23.5KB) and `/statistics/news/2026-mid-year-hull-report/` (11.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with the methodology paragraphs read verbatim; **no report, index file, fact sheet or clause text was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**Cefor（The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers，北歐水險協會）** 是**北歐水險業的行業組織**（頁腳自述「Cefor - The Nordic Association of Marine Insurers, P.O Box 2550 Solli, NO-0202 OSLO, Norway」）。本條目補的是**「專業險種自己的共享數據層」這一形態**：**實測池內水險／貨運險／船舶險相關條目為 0**——**注意一個假命中**：「hull」曾命中 [[hull-white-esg-checks]]，**但那是 Hull-White 利率模型，與船舶險無關**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home」**；⭐ **「Statistics」頁 14.5KB**；⭐ **「NoMIS」頁 12.2KB**，正文寫明 **「Here you can download the lastest and historical versions of Nordic Marine Insurance Statistics (NoMIS) Reports, Cefor Annual Reports and half yearly NoMIS statistics」**，並列出 **2026–2021 共六年年度檔**；⭐ **「Coastal Hull Index」頁 14.7KB**，正文寫明 **「…may be composed as a weighted index」**，且 **「The weight is the typical average % split of claims into steel, other materials and labour costs. This is coupled with three indices from Statistics Norway (SSB)」**——**按鋼鐵／其他材料／人工的典型賠款佔比加權，再與挪威統計局（SSB）三個指數結合**；**同頁 Cefor 自行聲明局限**：**「the actual claims cost trend in any one year may differ from such a calculated index…」**，並寫明近期**實際理賠成本通脹高於按 SSB 推算的指數**；⭐ **「Cefor in Figures」頁 15.1KB**，含 **2026 Cefor in Figures**、**2025 Cefor Facts**、**The Cefor Marine Insurance Market 2024 (premiums)** 等檔期；**「Hull Clauses」頁 23.5KB**；**「2026 Mid-year hull report」頁 11.1KB**；導航另含 **Nordic Plan（標準水險合同）**、**Cargo Clauses**、**Small craft clauses**、**Nordic Offshore Wind Insurance Conditions（離岸風電保險條件）**、**Safety regulations**、**Ask the analyst**、**NoMIS Special focus analyses**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「水險」這一整條業務線**——池內險種側**極密於壽險／健康險／車險／財產險／巨災**，**唯獨水險與貨運險為 0**。**② ⭐ 「理賠通脹指數」是本輪最有教學價值的發現**——池內已有 [[claims-inflation-motor-my]] 與 [[inflation-aware-xol-reserving]]，而 **Cefor 給出「第三種險種、方法論完全公開」的理賠通脹構造**（**按成本構成加權 → 掛接國家統計局投入指數**），**且把方法局限寫在頁面上**（**合成指數與實際賠款趨勢可能背離**）——**對做「理賠通脹假設」的學生是可直接引用的方法樣本與警示**（可與 [[lossratio-r]]、[[gi-loss-reserving]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 並讀）。**③ 「共享理賠統計」機制本身值得注意**——**由行業組織匯總多家公司理賠數據形成共同基準（NoMIS）**，**既非監管強制申報、亦非公開數據，而是行業自組織共享池**；對研究**數據共享激勵**的學生，這是與 [[susep-sro]]（監管強制逐筆登記）**完全相反的路线**。**④ 離岸風電保險條件與條款亦在此站**——與 [[oasis-piwind]] 構成**「條款側 + 量化側」一對**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量、六年檔期、指數方法論與 Cefor 自述局限、以及條款導航條目**，**但未下載任何 NoMIS 報告、未下載任何年度檔、未打開沿海船體指數檔案、未打開任何 Fact Sheet 或條款文本**，故**不能轉述任何具體損失率、保費規模、指數數值或條款條文**；**② 指數的具體數值與權重比例未讀取**；**③ 站點設有 Log in 區域，會員專區範圍未核實**；**④ NoMIS 的成員覆蓋範圍未核實**；**⑤ 與北歐各國監管、與 IUMI 的關係未核實**；**⑥ 首頁標題實測僅為「Home」，信息量低，故本條目標題與摘要依據各功能頁**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Cefor 提供精算軟件或建模工具**。**核實說明**：七個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取方法論段落；**未下載報告、指數檔案、Fact Sheet 或條款文本**。
